expected_tradeoff: A stays 0.0000 and F stays 0.0000 because no RBAC grant, released-record set, or deletion path changes: the widenings are lexical aliases that only affect which records become candidates, and the label change only stops incidental denials from downgrading a complete answer. U rises by the subset of its 0.611 deficit attributable to the 7 buildable checkpoints (two mechanisms); the remaining evidence_withheld loss (4 checkpoints, P2 of the critique) is not fixable without changing contract tests that protect F, and is left as a documented structural cost of the conservative forgetting posture rather than bought with an A/F regression.
retrieval_loop: retrieve() keeps its exact gate ordering: gate 0 responsiveness runs before gate 1 tombstone, gate 2 role_grants, gate 3 relationships/scope; every candidate is cross-referenced against the RBAC join; denied lists only ever contain records the query is actually about. Changes this iteration: (a) _distinctive_terms additionally tokenizes digit-runs inside hyphen/dot-separated tokens and retains all-digit tokens of length >=2, applied symmetrically at ingest and query; (b) a small _CONTACT_TAG synthetic term is added on both sides when text carries a phone/digit pattern or contact/logistics sense words, so paraphrase contact queries (who do I call, reach the clinic, the callback line) meet the stored front-desk / backup-line records they are about without widening the candidate set for clinical content; (c) PASS-1 rank key becomes (overlap, structural, seq) DESC with overlap still primary (relevance outranks recency) and top_k still a hard cap on allowed; structural = 1 when the candidate shares a digit-run or contact-tag hash with the query, so an early scheduling record tied at overlap 1 is not pushed past the cap by unrelated mid-episode marginal records; (d) while filing an RBAC/scope denial, decision records whether the denial is answer-bearing (overlap beyond the tag-only match) so the action label can distinguish a real withheld answer from a query that merely touched an unrelated denied row.
forgetting_mechanism: UNCHANGED this iteration. tombstone() still inserts the tombstone and, in the same transaction, purges record_terms for the record, zeroes plaintext body, and calls shred() which NULLs crypto_keys.key_material, sets shredded_at, zeroes ciphertext to x'' and clears key_id on the row. No vocabulary is retained past deletion on any path, so deleted content is unrecoverable by any query path and adversarial prompts cannot reconstruct it; no_memory from any tombstone denial continues to beat all other branches in sanitize_and_decide.
